source: user-selected 61 original-game Tips; T029 removed by human; T050/T052 merged

items.text: After selecting units, use right_click on a position or target in the currently actionable view. The game chooses an action such as moving, attacking, or working based on the target and unit context.
Before gathering gas, build the appropriate Refinery, Extractor, or Assimilator on a Vespene Geyser.
Read the current command_card and use activate_button with a button that is currently available. For commands that request a target, use the returned target ticket.
Use the lifecycle restart operation to restart the current mission. Restart discards unsaved current progress and invalidates old action/session references.
Use the lifecycle objectives operation to read the current mission objectives.
Terran infantry can enter a Bunker, where they are sheltered and can return fire. Select the infantry and use right_click on the Bunker.
A Vulture can deploy Spider Mines. Select it and use the Use Spider Mines button shown on the current command_card; if the command requests a target, use target_at to designate ground.
Select a building and use the required production button on its current command_card to add a unit to the production queue. The original Tip says the queue holds up to five items.
Stimpack increases the attack and movement rates of Marines and Firebats. Each use costs 10 hit points.
Some missions require specific units to reach a glowing Command Point Marker (Beacon).
When building a Command Center, Nexus, or Hatchery, try to place it close to resources.
Wraiths and Ghosts can use Cloak. The original Tip says cloaked units cannot be attacked unless enemy detection units spot them.
Read the current production queue, then use its production ticket and queue position with cancel_production to cancel one item at a time.
A Dropship transports units quickly and is built at a Starport. Select one or more units, then use right_click on the Dropship to load them.
Use move_selected to move units; they ignore enemies along the way. This can also be used to retreat.
Many Terran buildings can fly. Select a building and use the Liftoff button shown on its current command_card. To land, use the available Land button and specify a location.
To have units engage enemies along the way, use attack_move on a target position.
You can land a friendly building beside a corresponding abandoned Terran add-on to take it over, such as a Machine Shop or Control Tower.
A Nuclear Silo is an add-on to a Command Center. To launch a nuclear attack, first build a nuclear missile in the Silo, then designate a target with a Ghost.
Use select_at with add=True to apply the native Shift-selection toggle to a unit in view, removing it from the current selection if selected.
Use select_at to select a target on the current screen.
Missile Turrets and Science Vessels detect cloaked units within range. A Comsat Station's Scanner Sweep can briefly detect units at a location on the map.
Select passengers and use right_click on a compatible friendly transport to load them. You can also specify passengers with the transport's current Load button.

Select a transport, read its current cargo from command_card, and use a passenger ticket with unload_one. To unload all, use the currently available Unload All button and specify an on-screen location if the interface requires one.
Zerg buildings must be built on creep, except for Hatcheries and Extractors. A Hatchery or creep colony can generate creep.
Use move_minimap, attack_move_minimap, or patrol_minimap to issue an order to a minimap position without first moving the main camera. GATHER is not available as a public minimap command.
Use camera to move the camera.
A Hatchery can be upgraded to a Lair and then to a Hive. These upgrades unlock more Zerg buildings.
Use lifecycle save and load operations to preserve and restore game progress. After loading, discard old session references and obtain current observations.
An Overlord can research a transport upgrade at a Lair or Hive. After the upgrade, select passengers and use right_click on a compatible friendly Overlord to load them.
A Queen can Infest a severely damaged Terran Command Center. It becomes a Zerg building that can produce Infested Terrans, which explode when they attack.
Use queued=True for Move, Attack, Patrol or right_click to append native orders. Each item costs an action. New-building placement does not support queued orders or automatic background continuation.
Use patrol or patrol_minimap to set a patrol destination. Patrolling units attack enemies they discover.
The original Tip says most Zerg ground units can Burrow. Burrowed units cannot attack and cannot be attacked while undetected.
Stationary combat units are on guard and automatically engage enemies they discover.
Select a unit and issue the currently available Hold Position button from its command_card. The unit attacks enemies within range while staying in place.
After a Spire is upgraded to a Greater Spire, Mutalisks can morph into Guardians.
Select an escort unit and use right_click on the friendly unit it should follow. The result depends on the unit and target state.
A Defiler can Consume a friendly unit. Each unit consumed restores 50 energy.
PLAGUE can deal up to 300 damage to units or buildings, but it cannot kill its target.
Scourge automatically attack nearby air units while patrolling. Use patrol to issue a patrol order.
A Queen's ENSNARE and a Defiler's PLAGUE can affect cloaked units, allowing other units to target them.
Keep the route between the Command Center and resources clear. Obstacles slow resource delivery.
Protoss buildings must be built within a Pylon's power field, except for the Nexus.
Use save_view for one of three camera bookmarks, and recall_view to return. Store labels and notes with explicit text budgets. Bookmarks remain camera coordinates, not unit positions.
Reavers attack by firing explosive Scarabs. Select a Reaver and use the Build Scarab button shown on its current command_card to produce them.
Different units can support one another. A mixed force may be more effective than a force made of only one unit type.
After a Probe starts warping in a building, it can take another task. This lets it start multiple buildings at once.
Use select_same_type to select up to twelve units of the same type on the current screen, following native selection rules.
PSIONIC STORM damages all units in its area of effect and is effective against tightly grouped enemies.
Two High Templars can combine into an Archon. Select both and use the Archon Warp button shown on the current command_card.
When a public event supplies camera_target, pass its x,y to camera to view the notification location. A notification without camera_target gives no camera destination.
HALLUCINATION creates multiple illusions of a unit. Use them to scout and draw enemy fire as decoys.

Use assign_group with the current selection and a slot from 0 through 9. Use select_group to recall that native group. Groups can contain units or buildings; a new game or load invalidates old action/session references.
Observers are useful for scouting: they remain permanently cloaked and can detect hidden units.
Carriers attack by launching Interceptors. Select a Carrier and use the Build Interceptor button shown on its current command_card to produce them.
An Arbiter cloaks nearby units but remains visible itself. Arbiters cannot cloak one another.
Units caught in an Arbiter's Stasis Field can neither attack nor be attacked while the effect lasts.
Arbiters can use Recall to teleport units instantly to their location.
